headline: Volumes rise on HG deal; interest costs squeeze earnings
summary_short: Revenue rose 7% y/y to $327M as the HG Acquisition's added throughput more than offset the Utica Shale Divestiture, but diluted EPS fell to $0.24 from $0.26 as interest expense on acquisition-related debt outpaced operating gains.
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue rose 7% y/y to $327M, driven by HG Acquisition throughput gains and CPI rate escalators, partially offset by the Utica Shale Divestiture and natural decline. Direct operating expenses grew 34% on HG-related costs, pushing operating income down 2% to $182M despite the revenue gain. Interest expense rose 16% to $56M on the 2033/2034 Notes issued for the $1.1B HG Acquisition, driving net income down 9% to $114M and diluted EPS to $0.24 from $0.26. Long-term debt rose 18% to $3.57B on the acquisition financing. The company paid a $0.225/share dividend, repurchased $8M of stock, and left its FY2026 capex budget unchanged at $190-220M.
